purpose: Exclaim conversationally about an extreme degree.
keywords: い-adjective + のなんのって; な-adjective + なのなんのって
The slope was so steep that I was out of breath.
The venue was unbelievably hot; I was drenched in sweat.
The new dog is so adorable that I keep taking photos.
formation: い-adjective + のなんのって; な-adjective + なのなんのって
restrictions: Often followed by an explanation of just how extreme it was.
mistake: It is an exclamation, not a literal question about what.
